purpose: Lexical crosswalk for classifying consequential socioeconomic choices during gameplay. Categories describe decisions and resource flows, not moral character.

lexicalSource.name: Open English WordNet
lexicalSource.method: Use the current Open English WordNet Q42 lexicon for exact lemma and part-of-speech validation when the generic Q42 range-query interface is available. The listed terms are candidates, not validated senses. Polysemous lemmas must retain all synset candidates and definitions; the game must not silently select a sense. The game concepts below are an application crosswalk, not a claim that WordNet defines socioeconomic policy.
lexicalSource.licenseSource: The source Turtle declares dc:license <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/> on the Open English WordNet lexicon.
lexicalSource.termStatus: Candidate lemmas only; synsets and senses are not yet resolved or validated in-game.

categories.label: Resource investment and allocation
categories.gameMeaning: Choice to commit scarce resources now in expectation of an outcome over time.

categories.label: Contribution and work
categories.gameMeaning: Money, labour, time, skill, care, or equipment supplied by a person or group.

categories.label: Cost and opportunity cost
categories.gameMeaning: Direct spending and the alternative use or need forgone by committing a resource.

categories.label: Benefit and return
categories.gameMeaning: Who receives income, service, capability, safety, authority, or other return, and when.

categories.label: Risk and exposure
categories.gameMeaning: Who carries financial, bodily, reputational, legal, housing, or delivery risk.

categories.label: Capability and maintenance
categories.gameMeaning: Whether an investment produces durable skills, usable assets, operation, repair, and local autonomy.

categories.label: Control and governance
categories.gameMeaning: Who sets terms, controls funds and artifacts, makes decisions, receives credit, and can seek review.

scopeSolarProject.costNarrative: unpaid planning time and personal money; basic-needs work or income is deferred

submitGrant.costNarrative: application labour and delay; result remains uncertain

reviseGrant.costNarrative: another unpaid workday after a declined application

raiseCommunityFunds.costNarrative: residents commit scarce money; earlier personal costs remain sunk

selfFundProject.costNarrative: personal savings and a workday are committed without reimbursement

registerOriginatorVendor.costNarrative: registration, insurance and tax paperwork are paid before selection is known

hireOriginator.costNarrative: current work is paid; earlier unpaid preparation is not reimbursed

hireFairly.costNarrative: installer is paid and routine maintenance is funded; prior personal losses remain

appointInsider.costNarrative: connected contractor is paid; creator credit, local know-how and maintenance are lost

mismanageGrant.costNarrative: public-purpose funds are spent without delivery or accounts

acceptGovernmentCapture.costNarrative: public money and control move; originator credit and authority are displaced

delegateToPoliticalBacker.costNarrative: connected contractor receives payment; maintenance and knowledge transfer are absent

contestGovernmentCapture.costNarrative: personal money, time and standing are risked for a remedy that may fail

recordAppropriation.costNarrative: one workday goes to preserving an account rather than paid work, care or rest

seekPoliceReview.costNarrative: a workday is spent seeking remedy; the conflicted process can close without action

publiciseAppropriation.costNarrative: visibility may increase understanding and retaliation or support loss

teachCrewUnpaid.costNarrative: local capability grows through the initiator’s unpaid work

repairTankLabour.costNarrative: one workday restores shared water access

repairTankCoins.costNarrative: personal money buys fittings to restore shared water

improveShelterLabour.costNarrative: one workday improves shelter but competes with earning and project work

endTurn.costNarrative: rest restores work capacity but consumes calendar time

measurementRule: For each action in the saved gameplay tape, replay the state before and after it and record actor, day, personal and shared money delta, labour/time used, action tags, stated purpose, who pays, intended beneficiaries, cost narrative, alternatives available at that point, and subsequent service/capability/control outcomes. Multiple category tags are allowed. Derive and revise the taxonomy from repeated choices and outcomes; never infer virtue, criminality, or social worth from a tag.
